verdict.rationale: Phaser's core is a client-side game framework, but the evidence also shows hosted services: the Game Agent with an MCP endpoint, account-based licences, and one-click publishing. Data storage location is therefore a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence documents choosing a storage region or any data-residency control for these hosted services.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
